name: dynamic-index-detection-rigid-two-inertia-coupling-is-rejected-with-named-states
source:
DYNAMIC rigid(t = 0 .. 1)
der(w1) = (10 - tau_c) / 2
der(w2) = tau_c / 3
w1 = w2
w1(0) = 0
w2(0) = 0
END

error.message: DYNAMIC rigid: the model is structurally index-2 or higher — an algebraic constraint relates differentiated states with no algebraic unknown left to determine: "w1=w2" (couples w1, w2). The integrators here solve index-1 systems: differentiate the constraint, put a compliance/storage element between the coupled states, or eliminate one state by substitution.
